preconditions.description: The number of towers in the bears' wall (n) and the elephant's wall (w) are integers between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 1000000000 for ai in a) and all(1 <= bi <= 1000000000 for bi in b)
preconditions.description: Each tower height in the bears' wall (a) and the elephant's wall (b) is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The input lists a and b have exactly n and w elements, respectively.

postconditions.expression: result == sum(1 for i in range(n - w + 1) if all(a[i + j] == b[j] for j in range(w)))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all segments of length w in the bears' wall (a) where the sequence of heights exactly matches the elephant's wall (b).
